trigger.description: Trigger is what started the run: "schedule", "manual" or "backfill".

for.description:
For is the time the run is for: the schedule slot, the backfilled day's
time, or the start of a manual run. Its inputs (today, since) follow it.

sessionId.description: SessionID is the run's saved agent CLI session, if it kept one.

slot.description: Slot is how records written before occurrences said For (schedule only).

outcome.description: Outcome and Reason are the run's result, as recorded in run status.

inputs.description: Inputs the routine ran with (e.g. today, since): what the run covered.

error.description: Error is the tool's error, when the call failed.

items.description: Write is a side-effecting tool call (intercepted in dry-run).

write.description:
Write is whether the tool can change things (not read-only): such
calls are intercepted in dry runs, and are also listed in Writes.

error.description: Error is the tool's error, when the call failed.

items.description: Call is one tool call a run made.

calls.description:
Calls are every tool call, in order (absent in records from before
they were kept).

costUsd.description:
CostUSD is the run's cost at API list prices: api runs only (claude-code
runs are on a Claude plan, and the app never works out a cost for them).

output.description:
Output is the result in the shape the routine declared (Dotprompt
output: schema), validated; absent for routines without one.

outcome.description:
Outcome is the routine's own report when the run succeeded: done or
nothing_to_do (a failed report fails the run). Reason says why.

result.description: Result is the agent's result, for runs that got as far as the model.

error.description: Error is how records written before outcomes were recorded said a run failed.
